info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Partners-v4-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Partners Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive list of loyalty partners associated with the program. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can effectively gather information about various partners, which can enhance customer engagement and loyalty initiatives. Typical consumers of this API include marketing teams, customer relationship managers, and application developers looking to integrate loyalty program features. With this resource, organizations can keep their customer base informed and provide a seamless experience when interacting with loyalty offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loyalty partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all available loyalty partners in the system. You can use this information to understand the partnerships and redeem loyalty benefits.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve loyalty partner information. This request body is used to specify any necessary parameters for filtering or customizing the response of the loyalty partners data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loyalty partners.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyPartnersRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the _s_loyalty_s_partners_ operations when retrieving partner information. It is expected to be a string formatted as JSON.
